dct_description_sm: The primary objective was to quantify and compare SOC concentration and stock in two contrasting tillage systems (NT with ZT system: NT/ZT; conventional, autumn plow tillage: CT) using FD and three ESM approaches (ESMcubic_spline, ESMlinear, and ESMnon_model).

dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Comparison of equivalent soil mass approaches to estimate soil organic carbon stocks under long-term tillage
